newsitem.title: USA: Tokheim has automated gasoline dispenser.
newsitem.headline: Tokheim has automated gasoline dispenser.

text.p: Tokheim Corp said Friday it completed product development of an automated gasoline dispenser for the retail petroleum market.
The product uses MicroStamp remote intelligent communications technology from Micron Communications Inc.

Tokheim, which makes petroleum dispensing equipment and related systems, said the new technology allows customers to communicate with gas dispensers from a distance with radio waves using a car-mounted tag or key fob that contains an intelligent chip and antenna.
